output.review_comment: The PR adds test-specific logic (p=50 averaging) that contradicts the original documented behavior ("values are never averaged or interpolated"). The docstring was modified to justify this special case rather than maintaining the specified nearest-rank method. Either: (1) implement the pure nearest-rank method consistently and investigate why tests expect different behavior, or (2) provide clear documentation of why the median case requires special handling with explicit approval from the team, since this contradicts the original spec agreed with the SRE team. Also verify that `math` module is imported at the top of the file.
